Name: SMALLBASE_LOT_MAP_COMBINATION_PARAM_ST
Description: Not read by the game: input of the offline map-pattern lottery. For a site lottery row (Pattern ID), each row is one combination of maps and how many sites of each map are placed (retail: the Evergaol maps).

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Set: the row is left out of the network test build. Retail: set on the blank row 0.

Fields.Name: Pattern ID
Fields.Description: LotBaseSmallBaseAndSpot row this combination belongs to. Retail: 20601-20605 (Evergaols).

Fields.Name: Unknown Weight
Fields.Description: Not read by the game. Retail: 100 on every combination (1 on the blank row); probably the combination's lottery weight.

Fields.Name: Map ID: 1
Fields.Description: SmallBaseMapVariationParam ID of the first map in the combination. -1 or 0: none.

Fields.Name: Map ID: 2
Fields.Description: SmallBaseMapVariationParam ID of the second map. -1 or 0: none.

Fields.Name: Map ID: 3
Fields.Description: SmallBaseMapVariationParam ID of the third map. -1 or 0: none.

Fields.Name: Map ID: 4
Fields.Description: SmallBaseMapVariationParam ID of the fourth map. -1 or 0: none.

Fields.Name: Map 1 Site Count
Fields.Description: Number of sites using Map ID 1 in this combination. Retail: 1-2; the counts add up to the lottery row's site count (Evergaol row 20605: 2 + 3 + 2 = 7).

Fields.Name: Map 2 Site Count
Fields.Description: Number of sites using Map ID 2 in this combination. Retail: 1-3.

Fields.Name: Map 3 Site Count
Fields.Description: Number of sites using Map ID 3 in this combination. Retail: 1-2.

Fields.Name: Map 4 Site Count
Fields.Description: Number of sites using Map ID 4 in this combination. Retail 0 on every row.
